Pickle Butter

3 Comments
Jump to Recipe Print Recipe
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:52
Instaread

Just a few ingredients transform butter into a tangy, flavorful, zesty spread that’s loaded with chopped pickles, herbs, and lemon zest. Perfect for spreading on sandwiches, crackers, and toast, or dolloped on grilled meats & veggies.

I couldn’t wait to make this easy dill pickle butter after seeing an Instagram reel of Chef Ayesha Nurdjaja making it. I had all the ingredients on hand and thought it would be perfect for sandwiches!!!

Pickle Butter

Ingredients:

  • ½ cup salted butter, softened to room temperature
  • 1½ dill pickles, chopped
  • 1 tbsp fresh dill, finely chopped (or 1 tsp dried dill)
  • 1 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped (or 1 tsp dried parsley)
  • 1 tsp shallot, finely minced
  • Zest from ½ lemon
  • Flaky sea salt, to taste, if desired

How to Make Pickle Butter:

Mix the softened butter with the dill pickles, dill, parsley, shallot, and zest.  Side Note: For a finer texture, pulse everything in a food processor until well combined.

Taste the pickle butter and add some flaked sea salt if desired.

To serve, spread on sandwiches, crackers, and toast, or dollop on top of grilled meats & veggies.

Store in an airtight, sealed jar in the fridge. Enjoy.

Pickle Butter

Print Recipe Pin Recipe Rate Recipe
Prep Time: 5 minutes minutes
Total Time: 5 minutes minutes
Course: Condiment
Cuisine: American
Author: Pam - For the Love of Cooking

Equipment

  • Rubber Spatula or Food Processor
  • Glass Jar with Lid

Ingredients

  • ½ cup salted butter softened to room temperature
  • 1½ small dill pickles chopped or minced
  • 1 tbsp fresh dill finely chopped (or 1 tsp dried dill)
  • 1 tbsp fresh parsley finely chopped (or 1 tsp dried parsley)
  • 1 tsp shallot finely minced
  • Zest from ½ lemon
  • Flaky sea salt to taste, if desired

Instructions

  • Mix the softened butter with the dill pickles, dill, parsley, shallot, and zest.  Side Note: For a finer texture, pulse everything in a food processor until well combined.
  • Taste the pickle butter and add flaked sea salt, to taste, if desired.
  • To serve, spread on sandwiches, crackers, and toast, or dollop on top of grilled meats & veggies.
  • Store in an airtight, sealed jar in the fridge. Enjoy.
